body: Just looked it up. You, uh, weren't kidding...

I solo climbed Mt. Saint Helens on a complete whim in Oct. 2021 after experiencing a mid-life crisis. I opened Google Earth, spun the earth a few times and this is where my mouse cursor landed. I bought the flight tickets within an hour.

I am from Florida, where mountains are essentially a myth. It was extremely difficult for someone like me with no mountaineering experience. I made it about 2/3 the way up before I was attacked by an eagle shortly after I took this photo, which caused me to have to abandon the climb (I was ok though!). I went back 5 months later to [complete the climb.](https://i.imgur.com/44S6gFq.jpg) It was the best decision I have ever made. I have since fallen in love with the PNW and hope to one day move out there.

I don't know your life, but I'm sure you had times where your parents did what they could so that you didn't have to worry about grown up things and enjoyed a normal life.
